smokeTestCommand: agent -p --output-format text --model composer-2.5 --trust "Reply with the single token ALLNIGHTER_READY"

setup.installHint: Install Cursor CLI with `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash`, then run `agent` or `agent login` if needed.

loginFlow.instructions: Run `agent login` and complete Cursor sign-in. If account-backed commands fail with Keychain errors, open Cursor once and retry setup.

headlessTrust.disclosure: Cursor Agent workers run with --trust: the agent may edit files, run shell commands, and use tools in the project workspace without per-run approval. This is required for headless Code workers and is separate from Bench or model enablement.
